description: The line plot illustrates the relationship between the number of tokens and the Macro-F1 Score (%) for two different models: "MATTER (ours)" and "w/o material information." The x-axis, labeled "Number of tokens," ranges from 0.6 to 1.4 and is marked with intervals of 0.2. The y-axis, labeled "Macro-F1 Score (%)," ranges from 48 to 58 and is marked with intervals of 2. The "MATTER (ours)" model, represented by a red line with circular markers, shows a general upward trend from approximately 55.5% at 0.6 tokens to a peak of about 58% at 1.0 token, followed by a decline to around 51.5% at 1.4 tokens. The "w/o material information" model, represented by a purple line with circular markers, shows a more stable trend, starting at approximately 52.5% at 0.6 tokens, peaking at around 54% at 0.7 tokens, and then gradually declining to about 48.5% at 1.4 tokens. The shaded areas around each line represent the confidence intervals for the respective models.
